content.title: Stifel lifts Biogen to Buy, sees potential Alzheimer’s narrative shift
content.summary: Investing.com -- Stifel upgraded Biogen (NASDAQ: BIIB) to Buy from Hold in a note Thursday, raising its price target to $202 from $144, saying the stock’s risk/reward profile is improving ahead of multiple clinical catalysts and a potential “narrative shift” in Alzheimer’s disease.
